Maya Patel: Heads-up — ZenWell (acct zen-112) autopay failed again when we tried charging the card on file. Decline code: 201 / acquirer: issuer_decline. Customer says card worked elsewhere. 
Nora Chen: They're on Pro annual, amount $62,400. Customer is panicking, asked for a manual payment link. 
Tony Ramirez: 3DS logs show multiple auth_window_timeouts around the same time, and one auth rejected with AVS mismatch. Could be issuer blocking large s2s payments. 
Maya Patel: Tried retrying the card once (per policy) — still fails. Billing page shows "card declined" and no SCA trigger. 
Liam O'Connor: Amount > $50k. We'll need finance lead + legal ok for manual wire. @payments-bot can you create a manual-collect ticket and flag for approval? :warning:
PaymentsBot: Created ticket PAY-8762. Assigned to @Liam O'Connor, priority: high. 
Nora Chen: Customer offered to pay by wire asap. Wants wire instructions now. They said ACH micro-deposits failed because bank flagged the account type as "corporate". 
Tony Ramirez: For ACH we can try a same-day verification via micro-deposits or Plaid instant if they have online login. But corporate accounts often block micro-deposits; sounds like wire is the fastest path. 
Maya Patel: Attaching wire details customer provided (they asked to confirm). 
Maya Patel: ```
Beneficiary: ZenWell Inc.
Bank: First West Commercial Bank
Account: 987654321
Routing/SWIFT: FWCBUS33
Reference: Invoice #INV-19721
Amount: $62,400 USD
Requested by: Nora Chen (customer contact)
```
Liam O'Connor: Ok. I need internal approval from @finance-directors for wires >50k and confirmation that KYC is complete. Nora — can you confirm ZenWell's billing contact, VAT ID, and incorporation docs were collected? 
Nora Chen: Sent incorporation docs and VAT in the CRM notes, billing contact is Rachel Lim (rachel@zenwell.health). I'll paste links in the ticket. 
Maya Patel: Also note their payment terms say 30 days but they requested immediate payment to avoid service impact. They gave a signed PO. 
Liam O'Connor: Good. I'll loop in @Finance Directors for sign-off. Approvers: myself + Priya Sharma + Legal. If we get thumbs up within 2 hours I'll trigger the wire. :thumbsup: 
PaymentsBot: Approval request sent to Priya Sharma and Legal. 
Priya Sharma: (via DM) I reviewed the docs, KYC looks fine, VAT verified. Approving manual wire given the PO and risk profile. :white_check_mark: 
Liam O'Connor: Approved. Maya, please confirm the beneficiary account by calling the bank or asking ZenWell for a bank letter. We do that for >50k wires. 
Maya Patel: On it — I'll call their finance lead now and confirm account ending 4321, and will update PAY-8762. 
Nora Chen: Customer reply: "Confirming account ends with 4321, sending bank letter within 30 mins." 
Tony Ramirez: Once wire is sent, update invoice as paid and set autopay off for that card to avoid retries. We'll recommend they re-add a different card or connect bank via Plaid later. 
Maya Patel: Wire scheduled after bank letter arrives and final confirmation. ETA to send: ~45–90 mins. I'll post final note here when sent. 
PaymentsBot: Event log: PAY-8762 status=awaiting-bank-letter -> pending-approval -> ready-to-send at 2228501620.
notes: Manual wire requested to avoid service disruption; internal approvals obtained; bank letter pending before wire send.
